Name: Stardew Archipelago
Author: ThatKaito
Description:
StardewArchipelago is an implementation of Stardew Valley for Archipelago.

We have a [url=https://discord.gg/fhmWZCvsUq]Dedicated Discord Server![/url]

[b]Archipelago is a [/b][b]multiworld multi-game randomizer.[/b] It is a cross-game modification system which randomizes different games, then uses the result to build a single unified multi-player game. Items from one game may be present in another, and you will need your fellow players to find items you need in their games to help you complete your own.

[url=https://archipelago.gg/]More information on the Archipelago Ecosystem[/url]

This mod allows Stardew Valley players to take part in the adventure!

[size=4][b]The Multiworld will contain rewards for the Stardew Valley player that are equivalent to every objective that they have randomized in their world.
[/b][/size]
[b]Seasons Randomizer[/b]
[list]
[*]All 4 seasons will be items, and one of them will be chosen randomly and added to the player's starting inventory[/*]
[*]At the end of each month, the player can choose the next season, instead of following the normal order. They can only choose seasons they have received unless they disabled the seasons randomizer.[/*]
[/list][b]Cropsanity[/b]
[list]
[*]Every seed in the game starts off locked and cannot be purchased from any merchant. Their unlocks are received as multiworld items, with a free sample of one seed for each.[/*]
[*]The way merchants sell seeds has been changed considerably for balance and more lore-accuracy. Pierre sells fewer seeds at a high price, while Joja sells unlimited seeds at a significant discount, but the player must purchase them in huge packs, not individually.[/*]
[*]Growing each seed the first time sends a location check[/*]
[/list][b]Museumsanity[/b]
[list]
[*]The items that are normally obtained from museum milestones are added to the item pool. Some items, like the magic rock candy, are duplicated for convenience.[/*]
[*]The traveling merchant now sells minerals and artifacts, with a strong bias towards undonated ones, to mitigate the effect of RNG on the run. The player must receive "Metal Detector" items for this to happen.[/*]
[/list][b]Tv Channels and Babies[/b]
[b]Trap Items[/b]
[list]
[*]Optionally, players can choose to add traps to their world. They can customize the difficulty of the traps, to spice up the experience[/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Future Versions[/b][/size]﻿

The official released version of Stardew Archipelago is version 7.
Version 8 is currently in-progress, and you can follow its development cycle on the [url=https://discord.gg/fhmWZCvsUq]Dedicated StardewArchipelago Discord![/url], or the [url=https://discord.gg/8Z65BR2]Archipelago Discord[/url][url=https://discord.gg/8Z65BR2][/url]

Suggestions are welcome!


[size=4][b]Multiplayer[/b][/size]

Local (several players on the same farm) Multiplayer is not supported at this time. The intended Archipelago experience is cross-world multiplayer. In the case of Stardew, this means having several players on their own Stardew Valley Farm.

You can use the in-game chat to talk with other players even in different games entirely, as long as their game also supports chatting.
You can gift item to and from other players through the mail system, and share money through the banking feature.
You can also see other players from your multiworld in-game, optionally.


[b][size=4]Other Mods[/size]

[size=3]We recommend using [/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to customize the StardewArchipelago configuration.[/size]﻿

[/b]StardewArchipelago offers support for a limited number of other mods. Adding these mods to your world through the yaml file will include them in the randomization! Check out the [url=https://github.com/agilbert1412/StardewArchipelago/blob/6.x.x/Documentation/Supported%20Mods.md]Supported Mods Guide[/url] for instructions.﻿

What is randomized in each mod depends on the mod content. Any content that fits the existing settings will get randomized (ex: new Entrances, new NPC hearts, new skills). Furthermore, some mods have exclusive new randomized content that fits the general concept.

While you can use other, unsuported mods with StardewArchipelago, it has not been designed with that in mind. Unsupported mods will not include randomized content.
Small, Quality of Life mods are usually welcome, while Big overhaul mods that interact directly with the same game elements as StardewArchipelago can cause conflicts and bugs.

If a problem arises, it is usually easy to disable the conflicting mod and continue playing.
